title: Docked desk at Nova Terra Central: the pilot's own verdigris curd sold into the station's curd bid as it refills, a 30-minute docked market watch
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-24 07:27 UTC; rewritten 2026-11-24 07:40 UTC (orders ENT-085 block MERCURY: no trader waits docked, F8; sell handed goods at or above the bids). A trader waited docked at Nova Terra Central with no open route (fill.py check 07:22 UTC). The first form crafted purified argon, which the pull record holds full (data/routes/pull.json: 519 held, max 57), so the dispatcher closed it before a run. Nova Terra's curd bid refills a unit at a time: sell-loot-at-nova-terra sold 1 verdigris curd into a 316 cr bid at 07:37 UTC after the book read no curd bid at 07:22 UTC; a trader's own storage there holds 509 curd (storage book 07:06 UTC), surplus (no reserve line). Each run sells what the bid takes at 250 or more, then a 30-minute watch with the book polled (market_poll), 0 fuel, no buy. Up to 2 ships.
